note: Server-side SoQL counts over ALL NYC 311 requests created in 2023 (dataset erm2-nwe9), retrieved 2026-11-15 during development via the NYC Open Data API. fetch_data.py re-runs these queries; the dataset is live, so counts can drift slightly.
queries_that_failed_during_development: Queries combining status='Closed' with other predicates, and GROUP BY over the full year, returned server errors or an implausible value (23,138,125 > total rows) through the fetch tool used; those counts are computed locally from the sample instead.
